name: Greenhouse
description: Greenhouse is a hiring software company. We create the technology, know-how and support for your business' hiring needs.

events.d: Runs when a candidate applies or is added to a job, optionally for chosen jobs.
Runs when an application is updated, including stage changes, optionally for chosen jobs.
Runs when a candidate profile is updated in Greenhouse.
Runs when a job is updated in Greenhouse.
Runs when a new candidate is added in Greenhouse.
Runs when an application is marked as hired, optionally for chosen jobs.
Runs when an application is rejected, optionally for chosen jobs.
Runs when a new job is created in Greenhouse.
Runs when a new offer is created, optionally for chosen jobs.
Runs when an offer is updated, including acceptance or rejection, optionally for chosen jobs.
Runs when an interview is scheduled, optionally for chosen jobs.
Runs when an interviewer submits a scorecard.
Runs when a note, email or activity is added to a candidate, optionally of chosen types.
Runs when a new job post is created in Greenhouse.
Create a candidate profile, optionally applying them to a job at the same time.
Update a candidate profile. Only the fields you fill in are changed.
Find candidates by email, tag, ID or recent changes.
Apply an existing tag from your tag library to a candidate.
Add a note, log an email, or record an activity on a candidate profile.
Attach a resume, cover letter or other file to an application from a URL or base64 content.
Add an education entry to a candidate profile.
Add a work history entry to a candidate profile.
Merge a duplicate candidate into another; the duplicate is deleted.
Permanently remove selected personal data from a candidate for privacy requests.
Permanently delete a candidate and all their applications.
Apply an existing candidate to a job, or add them as a prospect.
Update the source, recruiter, coordinator, referrer or custom fields of an application.
Move an application to another interview stage, or transfer it to a different job.
Reject an application with a reason, optionally sending a rejection email.
Bring a rejected application back into the hiring process.
Mark an application as hired and fill one of the job openings.
Find applications by candidate, job, status, stage or recent changes.
Turn a prospect into an active candidate on a job.
Permanently delete one application. The candidate is kept.
Find jobs by status, department, office, requisition ID or recent changes.
Create a job from a template job with one or more openings.
Update a job name, notes, department, offices, requisition ID or custom fields.
Add a headcount opening to a job.
Close, reopen or edit an opening on a job.
Add an internal note to a job.
Find the public or internal job posts of a job.
Change a job post title or description, or publish or unpublish it.
Create an offer on an application.
Update the dates or fields of the current offer. Some changes create a new offer version.
Find offers by candidate, application, job or status.
Record an interview already on your calendar against a candidate application.
Change the time, panel, organizer, location or link of a scheduled interview.
Cancel and delete a scheduled interview in Greenhouse.
Find interviews by job, application, status or start time.
Find interview scorecards by application, interviewer, status or submission time.
Find Greenhouse users by email, employee ID or status.
Create a Greenhouse user with basic permissions.
Reactivate a deactivated Greenhouse user.
Deactivate a Greenhouse user. Their history is kept.
List departments, optionally by parent or external ID.
List offices, optionally by parent or external ID.
